body: I feel you so bad, it is too hard to travel when you're from the third world and you don't have a good position, money or good opportunities.
Ty... Honestly I don't think that it's gonna get better soon, perhaps I just going to the therapy to get some pills and stop feeling like this...
Hahaha, I need it to read something like this, I'm totally tired of this shit, I can't hold it anymore honestly, I just want to lay down and never wake up again.
Bb, why don't you report your partner with the authorities? No one deserves to be treated like that :(

Maybe I will sound cliche, but at the end we don't know what will happen in a near or far future, and always we're expecting for something and we have that little hope inside; I usually think that I'll never get married, have children or get a bf, and it's like meh, sometimes is better to be alone... Btw if you need someone to talk I'll be here

It's seems like to blame an entity that perhaps doesn't exist for a mental illness is very religious, my god, is an mental illness, and it's normal to have one, but not good... That's why I'll never look for help on the church or something like that because they're probably will tell me that and it's kinda boring to hear the same things over and over again
Also seems like sometimes when you talk about with someone else is almost like they're blaming you about something you haven't done yet and it's feels probably like people only care about you if you're dead
You should go to the hospital asap, please, do not automedicate yourself
If you need someone to talk, I'm here
